Dear Reviewer Team,
We have now finished developing our entire smart contract infrastructure and the backend analytics platform. The smart contract infrastructure, including the necessary scripts to interact with our fund smart contracts, can be found in our GitHub repository. For the sake of transparency and to make reviewing this milestone easier, we decided to open-source our entire smart contract codebase:
 https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-stable-gain-contracts.
The smart contract is deployed at the following address: https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/address/607f0848712918ad83acdaba153acf70b520a325ea58d44a7ebcd5f3a1
Moreover, we have prepared a test user with the address addr_test1vphwgk3nk2w3tygqwm50ssah3d8gduu5e3ycy2tem2sqh7c83z29s, which interacts with the fund (example: https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/db2603d62c789d7dedce447812d68c37534ed0c0cd353246559f4a41c87376ec?tab=utxo).
In addition, we wrote a comprehensive README.md that links to various python scripts that build example transaction for interacting with the fund: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/linkage-stable-gain-contracts/blob/main/README.md
As requested in the previous milestone feedback we have now first finished our interface development and deployed a testnet interface with which you can interact with the linkage fund protocol on preprod testnet here: https://preprod.linkage.finance/
・Funds Overview: https://preprod.linkage.finance/?searchValue=&onlyVerified=true&totalLockedRange=0&totalLockedRange=1000000&priceChan
